name: Aki no Miko
source:
Main character is a ronin who has enough time till entrance exams to have some rest in the countryside. His girlfriend broke up with him lately. A pretty shrine maiden appears before him on the trip to the mountains. She perfectly fits his taste.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名备考生，距离升学考试还有一段时间，于是前往乡下休息。最近，女朋友刚刚与他分手。上山途中，一名漂亮的巫女出现在他面前，而且完全符合他的喜好。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
